title: Effect Events: only call them inside Effects

slides.say: Effect Events are very limited on purpose.

slides.text: Only call them from inside Effects (or other Effect Events). Never during render.
slides.say: Only call them from inside Effects, or other Effect Events. Never during rendering.
Never pass them to other components or Hooks. Declare each Effect Event right next to the Effect that uses it.

slides.text: Their identity changes every render on purpose. So never list them as dependencies.
slides.say: Their identity intentionally changes on every render. That is one more reason to keep them out of dependency arrays.
